company_grievance.en:
SUBJECT: Refund of ₹3,499 not received for returned headphones, Order [ORDER NUMBER]

DESCRIPTION:
Dear Grievance Officer,

On 28 Sep 2026 I bought headphones from ShopKart for ₹3,499 (Order [ORDER NUMBER]). The headphones were faulty, so I returned them. ShopKart picked up the return on [DATE OF PICKUP]. I have not received my refund of ₹3,499.

On 15 Oct 2026 I complained to ShopKart in writing about this (reference [COMPLAINT REFERENCE NUMBER]). I have received no response.

Under the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020, rule 4(5), ShopKart's grievance officer must acknowledge a complaint within 48 hours and resolve it within one month. My complaint should have been acknowledged by 17 Oct 2026 and resolved by 15 Nov 2026. Both dates have passed.

Please resolve this now.

Regards,
[YOUR FULL NAME]
[REGISTERED MOBILE NUMBER]
[REGISTERED EMAIL ADDRESS]

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. Refund ₹3,499 to my original payment method, [CARD OR ACCOUNT LAST 4 DIGITS].
2. Confirm the refund in writing, with the transaction reference and date.
3. Send a written reply to this complaint, with a ticket number.
4. Explain why my complaint of 15 Oct 2026 got no response.

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- Order invoice or confirmation for the purchase on 28 Sep 2026
- Return pickup confirmation (SMS, email or app screenshot)
- Copy of my written complaint of 15 Oct 2026
- Bank or card statement showing no refund received

nch.en:
SUBJECT: Refund of ₹3,499 not received from ShopKart after return of faulty headphones

DESCRIPTION:
My name is [YOUR FULL NAME]. I am contacting the National Consumer Helpline, Department of Consumer Affairs, about a refund I have not received from ShopKart, an e-commerce company.

On 28 Sep 2026, I bought headphones from ShopKart for ₹3,499. My order number is [ORDER NUMBER]. The headphones were faulty, so I returned them. ShopKart picked up the return on [DATE OF RETURN PICKUP].

The refund of ₹3,499 has not reached me. I paid by [PAYMENT METHOD], ending in [ACCOUNT OR CARD LAST 4 DIGITS].

On 15 Oct 2026, I complained to ShopKart in writing. My complaint reference is [COMPLAINT REFERENCE NUMBER]. ShopKart has not replied.

I understand that the National Consumer Helpline takes up complaints with the company before a consumer goes to a commission. I request your help to resolve this with ShopKart.

My contact details are [YOUR MOBILE NUMBER] and [YOUR EMAIL ADDRESS].

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. Please take up my complaint with ShopKart.
2. Please ask ShopKart to refund ₹3,499 to my original payment method.
3. Please ask ShopKart to give me a written reply with the refund status and transaction reference.

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- Order invoice or confirmation for the 28 Sep 2026 purchase
- Payment proof for ₹3,499
- Return pickup confirmation from ShopKart
- Copy of my written complaint to ShopKart dated 15 Oct 2026
- Bank or card statement showing no refund received

consumer_commission.en:
SUBJECT: Consumer complaint against ShopKart for non-refund of ₹3,499 for returned faulty headphones

DESCRIPTION:
I am [YOUR FULL NAME], of [YOUR ADDRESS]. On 28 Sep 2026, I bought headphones from ShopKart for ₹3,499 (order number [ORDER NUMBER]). The headphones were faulty, so I returned them. ShopKart picked up the return on [DATE OF RETURN PICKUP]. I have not received the refund.

On 15 Oct 2026, I complained to ShopKart in writing (reference [COMPLAINT REFERENCE NUMBER]). ShopKart has not replied, and the amount has not been refunded.

I paid ₹3,499. Under the Consumer Protection (Jurisdiction) Rules 2021, G.S.R. 912(E), this District Commission hears this complaint. Under the Consumer commission filing-fee notification G.S.R. 606(E), 2023, the filing fee is nil. I am filing within 2 years of the cause of action, as required by section 69 of the Consumer Protection Act 2019. I am filing online through e-Jagriti, Department of Consumer Affairs.

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. Direct ShopKart to refund ₹3,499 for the returned headphones.
2. Award compensation for the delay and inconvenience, as the Commission considers fair.
3. Award the cost of this complaint.
4. Grant any other relief the Commission considers fair.

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- Order confirmation or invoice for ₹3,499 dated 28 Sep 2026
- Proof of payment (bank or card statement, showing only [ACCOUNT LAST 4 DIGITS])
- Return request and pickup confirmation
- Copy of my written complaint dated 15 Oct 2026
- Any screenshots showing the refund is still pending
- Proof of identity and address
consumer_commission.hi:
SUBJECT: ShopKart से ₹3,499 का रिफ़ंड न मिलने के संबंध में उपभोक्ता शिकायत

DESCRIPTION:
मैं, [आपका पूरा नाम], [आपका पता], यह शिकायत ShopKart के विरुद्ध दर्ज कर रहा/रही हूँ।

मैंने 28 Sep 2026 को ShopKart से ₹3,499 के हेडफ़ोन खरीदे थे। ऑर्डर नंबर [ऑर्डर नंबर] है। हेडफ़ोन ख़राब निकले, इसलिए मैंने उन्हें वापस किया। ShopKart ने [पिकअप की तारीख़] को सामान उठा लिया। फिर भी मुझे आज तक ₹3,499 का रिफ़ंड नहीं मिला है।

मैंने 15 Oct 2026 को ShopKart से लिखित शिकायत की। शिकायत संख्या [शिकायत संदर्भ संख्या] है। ShopKart की ओर से कोई जवाब नहीं आया। रिफ़ंड भी नहीं हुआ।

Consumer Protection Act 2019, section 69 के अनुसार यह शिकायत समस्या होने के 2 वर्ष के भीतर दर्ज की जा रही है। Consumer Protection (Jurisdiction) Rules 2021, G.S.R. 912(E) के अनुसार राशि ₹50 लाख तक होने से यह मामला ज़िला आयोग के अधिकार क्षेत्र में आता है। Consumer commission filing-fee notification G.S.R. 606(E), 2023 के अनुसार ₹5 लाख तक की राशि पर कोई शुल्क नहीं है। यह शिकायत e-Jagriti, Department of Consumer Affairs के माध्यम से e-jagriti.gov.in पर दर्ज की जा रही है।

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. ShopKart को ₹3,499 का पूरा रिफ़ंड देने का निर्देश दिया जाए।
2. मुझे हुई असुविधा के लिए आयोग जो उचित समझे, वह मुआवज़ा दिलाया जाए।
3. शिकायत का ख़र्च दिलाया जाए।

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- ऑर्डर की पुष्टि या इनवॉइस (28 Sep 2026)
- भुगतान का प्रमाण (₹3,499)
- रिटर्न पिकअप की पुष्टि
- 15 Oct 2026 की लिखित शिकायत की प्रति
- पहचान पत्र और पते का प्रमाण
